currency.basis: Official homepage logo fetched 2026-10-04 shows the compass emblem in current use; the stored eight-point star-cross corresponds to the pre-rebrand Finansbank/QNB mark and is no longer used by the bank.

identity.basis: The replacement four-arrow compass emblem is the exact mark displayed on the bank's own homepage for QNB (Turkey; QNB Finansbank uses the group mark), visually identical in arm arrangement, gradients and proportions.

assessment.independenceRationale: Primary evidence is the bank's own homepage asset; the Commons vector is an independent host whose rendered emblem matches the official PNG, not a mirror of it.

variant.basis: Candidate is the standalone emblem variant of the current lockup, cropped from the original vector without geometry changes; emblem-only presentation is the form used in app icons and favicons.

candidate.detailsJudgement: All four arrow arms keep their original path data and gradient stops; edges crisp, no lost detail or invented colors versus the source render.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Emblem is square (434.4x434.6), centered by the crop, complete with no clipping; diagnostic renders at 24/32/48 px remain recognizable on both themes.
candidate.rationale: Standalone emblem extracted from the Wikimedia Commons QNB Group vector lockup whose render matches the logo currently served on qnb.com.tr; replaces the superseded flat eight-point star-cross icon with the current four-arrow compass mark.
candidate.role: standalone brand emblem (compass of four inward arrows) from the official lockup

proposals.reason: The stored icon is an older flat #305da2 eight-point star-cross; the live QNB brand mark is a four-arrow compass emblem with blue/magenta gradients, shown as the logo on the official qnb.com.tr homepage and available as a genuine original vector on Wikimedia Commons (attributed to QNB Group). Evidenced rebrand plus corrected geometry/colors meet the update bar. The candidate is the emblem-only extraction of the Commons lockup (wordmark and gray outline dropped, viewBox cropped to the emblem), not a redraw.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Original vector replacement for an evidenced rebrand: the four-arrow compass emblem extracted from the Commons QNB Group lockup matches the emblem on the bank's live homepage. Emblem paths and gradients are preserved byte-for-byte from the original vector; the final working candidate will crop the viewBox to the emblem square and drop the wordmark/gray outline paths.
